summary: Every Pedal Gate setting carries over in its own units: threshold, hysteresis, attack, hold, release, range, detection and lookahead. Neo Gate's Ratio is set to infinity (a hard gate down to Range), the key filters are off and the sidechain internal.

rules.why: Neo Gate has no bypass parameter: the machine's bypass takes it.

remarks: Neo Gate keeps Pedal Gate's state machine (open at the threshold, close Hysteresis below it, hold, then the release) and its linear gain ramps, on the shared detector the de-esser also uses; at the carried settings it matches Pedal Gate to within 0.1 dB over any 50 ms window.
Neo Gate adds what Pedal Gate does not have: an expansion ratio, key filters, an external sidechain on its second input, Listen and Delta.

tolerance.measured: NeoBuzz.PedalTests (Linux), noise bursts through both at five settings (defaults, a short hold, RMS detection, 12 dB range, 5 ms lookahead): loudness difference 0.00 dB, worst 50 ms window 0.01 to 0.10 dB; 0.01 to 1.22 % of samples differ by more than 1e-5 (Pedal Gate ramps in float, Neo Gate in double)
